propositions: Read CLI surfaces (show/list/search/ready) can return empty stdout with exit 0 when the reconverge lock times out during concurrent writes, rather than producing parseable JSON or raising a nonzero exit.

The generic read-path property that all CLI surfaces share via ensure_fresh must guarantee that exit 0 implies parseable JSON output matching the surface's documented shape (dict for show, list for list/search/ready), with valid-empty [] being distinguishable from truncated-empty stdout.

Throttle marker `/tmp/.ticket-sync-<md5(tracker)>` must be cleared before each parameterized read invocation to ensure every surface actually exercises the reconverge path rather than short-circuiting to the local snapshot.
The ed2b harness and helpers (repo_with_origin_tickets, _rebar_cli, _clear_sync_throttle) must be hoisted and reused across write-burst contention tests rather than duplicated per-surface.
